2. Sūtrasthasyāpiśabdasyārthaṃ bhāṣyakāro vyācaṣṭe-- sa na kevalam iti / Sa sāmānyanirbījayogaḥ,
na kevalaṃ samādhiprajñāyā virodhī bhāvābhāvarūpeṇa, api tu krameṇa prajñākṛtasaṃskārāṇām api
pratibandhī atyantam abhibhāvaka ity arthaḥ / Nanu yadi prajñākṛtasaṃskārāṇām api [a]saṃprajñāto
bādhakas tarhi sakṛd asaṃprajñātād eva sarvasaṃskārabādhe vyutthānaṃ kadāpi kasyāpi na syād ity
āśayenākṣipati-- kasmād iti / Pariharati-- nirodhaja iti / Na nirodhaḥ sākṣād eva prajñāsaṃskārān
vilāpayati kiṃ tu nirodhaparaṃparājanyo dṛḍhataraḥ saṃskāra eva prajñā
